mapper.sql: select d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name,d.simple_name,d.interial_id, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time,d.origin, d.thrid_Dept_Id, d.thrid_Parent_Id, d.thrid_Org_Type, d.thrid_org_level from sys_dept d
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from sys_dept where del_flag = '0' and parent_id = #{deptId} limit 1
select * from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)

select * from sys_dept d INNER JOIN
tb_template tt on tt.using_unit_no = d.dept_id
tb_bidding_mark_template tt on tt.use_unit = d.dept_id
(find_in_set(#{deptId},d.ancestors) OR d.dept_id=#{deptId} ) and d.del_flag = '0'
(find_in_set(#{deptId},d.ancestors) OR d.dept_id=#{deptId} or d.thrid_dept_id='1000000000') and d.del_flag = '0'
GROUP BY d.dept_id
select count(*) from sys_dept where status = 0 and del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)
where dept_name=#{deptName} and parent_id = #{parentId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept( dept_id, parent_id, dept_name, ancestors, order_num, leader, phone, email, status, create_by, create_time )values( #{deptId}, #{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{ancestors}, #{orderNum}, #{leader}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update sys_dept set status = '0' where dept_id in
#{deptId}
mapper.delete: update sys_dept set del_flag = '2' where dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.select: where d.del_flag = '0' and d.origin = 'syncthird' and (d.ancestors is null or d.ancestors = '') order by d.order_num

where d.origin = 'syncthird'
AND d.ancestors like CONCAT(#{ancestors}, '%')
AND (d.thrid_org_type = 'A' OR d.thrid_org_type = 'F')
order by d.order_num
WHERE d.thrid_org_level IS NOT NULL order by d.parent_id, d.order_num

WHERE ((d.thrid_parent_id in (select dd.thrid_dept_id from sys_dept dd where dd.thrid_org_level IS NOT NULL AND dd.thrid_org_type not in ('BM','D','X') AND dd.status = '0')) and d.thrid_org_type not in ('BM','D','X') AND d.status = '0') or (d.thrid_org_type not in ('BM','D','X') AND d.status = '0' AND d.thrid_org_level IS NOT NULL ) order by d.parent_id, d.order_num
